measures.what: Please measure disk outside diameter and PCB thickness; the diameters and centre-to-centre distance of the two mounting holes; and each hole's (x,y) position relative to the disk centre, with +y toward the input wires. Also measure the tallest rear protrusion (connector/solder included), and its position/footprint on the back. Approximate sketches described in words are fine.
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: Please give perfboard width × length, PCB thickness, corner-hole diameters and centre spacings, and tallest components above and solder below. For USB access: with perfboard +y along its long side, which edge does the USB port face, and where is the port-mouth centre relative to perfboard centre (x,y,height above PCB top)? Please also describe/measure the USB plug body width, height and insertion/access space needed. Finally, can you estimate the LED disk's rear connector height/location, wire length to perfboard, and confirm the disk is Adafruit 2477 (nominal 160 mm diameter)?
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: For an unambiguous USB opening: looking down onto the perfboard component side, choose +y along the 70 mm length and +x along the 50 mm width. Does the port face +x, -x, +y or -y? Measure port-mouth centre x and y from the perfboard centre and its height above the perfboard (rough values fine). Is the 7.53 mm gap along the direction the USB plug enters? Can you measure your USB plug body width/height and usable projecting metal length? Also: do you have at least four M2x6 self-tapping screws for the perfboard? Can you confirm Adafruit 2477/160 mm disk and estimate rear-connector protrusion and wire length? Are the two wall screws already installed; if yes, their spacing and head/shank diameters?
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.item: own:esp32 USB port orientation on own:perfboard
measures.what: One essential orientation check: does the USB port point out of a 50 mm short edge of the perfboard (along its 70 mm length), or a 70 mm long edge (across its 50 mm width)? Which end/side? If you can't measure anything else, just describe that. Also please say whether the USB cable's plug can reach the port without hitting the perfboard, and whether the two disk mounting holes have component-free space for an M3 screw head and nut-sized support beneath.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.item: wall hanging screws and remaining fit checks
measures.what: Are two suitable wall screws/anchors already available or installed? Please give their spacing, shank diameter, head diameter, and head stand-off if possible. The listed machine screws cannot safely screw straight into a wall. Also, can you confirm enough wire slack for the disk to sit about 45 mm above the perfboard, and whether any rear disk parts occupy the 16 mm-wide strip through its two central mounting holes? If these cannot be checked, please say so.
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

limitations.wanted: Produce a verified tight USB aperture, disk clearance, exact ESP32 placement and matte-white print.
limitations.blocked_by: USB orientation and the meaning of its offsets remain unresolved; disk thickness, rear protrusions, wire slack and plug envelope were not measurable. Only black PLA is listed.
limitations.why: The design instead uses broad access windows, conservative overhead clearance and mandatory fit checks; the ESP32 placement is provisional. White filament must be obtained separately.
